title: The Tale of Peter Rabbit
source: Retold from Beatrix Potter, The Tale of Peter Rabbit (1902), public domain. https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/14838

text: Once upon a time there were four little rabbits: Flopsy, Mopsy, Cotton-tail, and Peter.
They lived with their mother in a sandbank, under the root of a very big fir tree.
pages.alt: Peter, his mother and his three sisters at their home under the fir tree

text: "You may go into the fields or down the lane," said Mrs. Rabbit, "but do not go into Mr. McGregor's garden."
"Now run along, and don't get into trouble."
pages.alt: Mrs. Rabbit warns Peter about the garden

text: Flopsy, Mopsy, and Cotton-tail, who were good little bunnies, went to gather blackberries.
But Peter, who was very naughty, ran straight to the garden and squeezed under the gate.
pages.alt: Peter squeezes under the garden gate while his sisters pick blackberries

text: First he ate some lettuces and some French beans, and then he ate some radishes.
Then, feeling rather sick, he went to look for some parsley.
pages.alt: Peter eats lettuces, beans and radishes

text: But round the end of a cucumber frame, whom should he meet but Mr. McGregor!
Mr. McGregor jumped up with a rake, calling out, "Stop, thief!"
pages.alt: Mr. McGregor jumps up with a rake

text: Peter was dreadfully frightened. He rushed all over the garden, for he had forgotten the way back to the gate.
He lost one of his shoes among the cabbages, and the other shoe amongst the potatoes.
pages.alt: Peter runs and loses his shoes among the cabbages

text: Then Peter ran into a gooseberry net and got caught by the large buttons on his jacket.
Some friendly sparrows flew to him and begged him to try hard. "Don't give up, Peter!"
pages.alt: Peter is caught in the gooseberry net and the sparrows cheer him on

text: Peter wriggled out just in time, leaving his jacket behind.
He jumped into a watering can to hide, but it was full of water. Kertyschoo! Mr. McGregor was after him in no time.
pages.alt: Peter hides in a watering can and sneezes

text: Peter crept past a pond where a white cat sat very still, staring at the goldfish.
At last he climbed onto a wheelbarrow, saw the gate, and ran as fast as he could. He slipped underneath and was safe at last!
pages.alt: Peter creeps past the white cat and runs for the gate

text: Peter was so tired that he flopped down on the soft sand floor of the rabbit hole.
His mother put him to bed and gave him a dose of camomile tea. But Flopsy, Mopsy, and Cotton-tail had bread and milk and blackberries for supper. The End.
pages.alt: Peter in bed with camomile tea while his sisters have blackberries
